test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Raja’s cap is in the form of a right circular cone of base radius 3 cm and slant height 25 cm. Find the area of the sheet required to make a cap. (Use pi = 3.14 correct to closest integer value)
solution:
**Given:**

Base radius of the cone (r) = 3 cm.

Slant height of the cone (l) = 25 cm.

π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of cone = π × r × l

**Calculation:**

Curved Surface Area = 3.14 × 3 × 25

⇒ Curved Surface Area = 3.14 × 75

⇒ Curved Surface Area = 235.5 cm²

Closest integer value = 236 cm²

**The area of the sheet required to make the cap is 236 cm².**
